WIZZ AIR CAPITAL MARKETS DAY
MEDIUM TERM TARGETS DEMONSTRATING PATHWAY TO SUSTAINED PROFITABILITY
Ticker:  WIZZ

London, 17 September 2026: Wizz Air Holdings Plc ("Wizz Air") will be holding a Capital Markets Day in London today for Institutional Investors and Sell-Side Analysts, starting at 2pm BST. József Váradi, Chief Executive Officer, will be joined by members of Wizz Air’s Management Committee.
The event will cover Wizz Air’s strategic priorities for the medium term to F30, including its plans to optimise the network and actively manage costs to deliver sustainable profitability.
Medium-term targets for F30 are;
Revenue EUR 10bn
Ex-Fuel CASK of EUR 3.00 cents
EBIT margin of 10%
Investment grade Balance sheet
Speakers will cover:
·    Wizz Air’s strategic refocusing of the business to its core CEE and selective growth markets;
·    The opportunity and plan to grow revenues per Available Seat Kilometers (ASKs) as the network matures, services a broader customer mix and leverages its leadership in key markets;
·    The continued focus on costs and the path to delivering a decline in ex-fuel unit costs over the medium term;
·    How a return to sustainable operating profits will underpin the deleveraging of the business whilst optimizing the financing decisions around fleet growth.
József Váradi, Chief Executive Officer said:
"Wizz Air’s strength has always been its ability to serve its customers through an uncompromising low-cost model.

Our next chapter is about turning that structural advantage into consistently stronger returns by concentrating growth in core and growth markets, restoring fleet productivity, maturing our network and executing with discipline.
By F30, we intend to operate an all-neo fleet of 335 aircraft, carry 127 million passengers and deliver sustainable, industry-leading margins.”
Current trading

No guidance for the F27 year will be provided today, however, Wizz Air announces the following updates: On the back of a stronger than expected summer revenue performance Q2 RASK is now guided flat YoY (from “down low single digits” previously) with ASK and H1 ex-fuel CASK guidance remaining unchanged. The current trading underpins the company’s strong liquidity position of above EUR 2.2bn. In reflection of geopolitical and fuel price volatilities, the company confirms it has already trimmed its originally planned H2 capacity by 5%.
Today's presentations can be found on the Wizz Air’s website (https://corporate.wizzair.com) from 12:00pm BST. A recording of the presentations will be made available after the event.
Institutional Investors and Sell-Side Analysts seeking registration details for the event should contact MHP: wizz@mhpgroup.com

About Wizz Air

Wizz Air operates a fleet of 269 Airbus A320 and A321 aircraft. A team of dedicated aviation professionals delivers superior service and very low fares, making Wizz Air the preferred choice of 69.7 million passengers in 2026 financial year. Wizz Air is listed on the London Stock Exchange under the ticker WIZZ. In 2025, Wizz Air topped the major airlines' emissions ranking, as presented by Cirium, an aviation analytics company, thanks to its work reducing emissions intensity. It was awarded Sustainable Airline of the Year 2025 at the Airline Economics Sustainability Awards Gala in September 2025. Wizz Air has also been recognized as the "Most Sustainable Low-Cost Airline" for six years running between 2021-2026 by World Finance Sustainability Awards.
